prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: replacement user-facing Five Elements model — Metal/Gold element
Input images: Image 1 is the locked clay material, lighting, softness, camera, and finish reference only; do not include the oracle character
Primary request: create an unmistakable cute stack of gold bars for the Metal element: five softly rounded rectangular gold bars arranged in a stable compact pyramid, three bars on the bottom and two on top, each bar slightly hand-shaped and pleasantly imperfect
Style/medium: premium handmade 3D polymer clay with a warm satin-gold metallic-clay finish, visibly sculpted rather than photoreal bullion; rounded collectible designer-toy proportions; subtle fingerprints and softly beveled edges; same polish as Image 1
Composition/framing: one centered isolated stack, front three-quarter view, compact strong silhouette readable at 64px, generous equal padding, no cropping
Lighting/mood: bright diffused studio daylight from upper left, soft neutral-lavender bounce; prosperous, precise, reassuring rather than flashy
Color palette: rich warm gold, champagne highlights, muted honey shadows, one subtle lilac reflected edge; gold remains dominant
Scene/backdrop: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key green (#00FF00), edge to edge, for clean post-production cutout
Constraints: exactly five visibly separate stacked gold bars in a 3-plus-2 arrangement; no character, face, eyes, text, numbers, stamps, currency marks, coins, jewelry, treasure chest, scenery, frame, watermark, cast shadow, background texture, or green reflection
Avoid: silver ingot shape, single bar, chaotic pile, photoreal bullion, mirror chrome, sharp dangerous corners, flat icon, glossy plastic, extra objects, magenta background
